# Project Submission

Thank you for contributing to the Kaduna Tech Ecosystem! Please fill out the information below to add your project.

## Project Information

**Project Name:** 
<!-- e.g., MyAwesomeApp -->

**Category:** 
<!-- REQUIRED: Must be exactly one of: Web App, Mobile App, SaaS, E-commerce, EdTech, FinTech, HealthTech, AgriTech, AI/ML, IoT, Developer Tools, Community, Other (case-sensitive) -->

**Description:** 
<!-- Provide a clear, concise description of your project (2-3 sentences) -->

**Tech Stack:** 
<!-- List the main technologies used, separated by commas (e.g., React, Node.js, MongoDB) -->

**Contact Name:** 
<!-- Your name or team name -->

**Contact Email:** 
<!-- Optional: Your email address -->

**Website:** 
<!-- Optional: Project website URL -->

**GitHub:** 
<!-- Optional: GitHub repository URL -->

**Twitter:** 
<!-- Optional: Twitter/X profile URL -->

---

## Checklist

Before submitting, please ensure:

- [ ] I have added my project to `projects.json` following the template format
- [ ] The category matches exactly one of the valid enum values (see categories.json)
- [ ] All information provided is accurate and up-to-date
- [ ] My project is based in or related to Kaduna
- [ ] The description is clear and free of spelling errors
- [ ] All URLs (if provided) are working and correct
- [ ] I have tested the changes locally (optional but recommended)

## Example Entry

```json
{
  "name": "My Project Name",
  "category": "Web App",
  "description": "A brief description of what your project does and its impact.",
  "techStack": ["JavaScript", "React", "Node.js"],
  "contactName": "Your Name",
  "contactEmail": "your.email@example.com",
  "website": "https://yourproject.com",
  "github": "https://github.com/yourusername/yourproject",
  "twitter": "https://twitter.com/yourhandle"
}
```
